permit.applies: The performance's organiser (演出举办单位) applies to the culture department of the province, autonomous region or municipality where the performance takes place; the performer then applies for the Z visa.
permit.first: The culture department's approval letter and the Approval of Short-term Employment for Foreigners working in P.R. China (or, outside a commercial performance, the Notice of Foreigner's Work Permit).

sources.title: Chinese Visa Application Service Center (Lahore), Visa Category: (Z) Work (2026-08-24)
sources.said: Commercial performance: An approval letter by the relevant Culture and Tourism Bureau in China, and Approval of Short-term Employment for Foreigners working in P.R.China.

sources.title: 泉州市文化广电和旅游局权责事项清单 (December 2024), quoting 《营业性演出管理条例》 art. 15 (Quanzhou Culture, Radio, Television and Tourism Bureau list of powers and duties, quoting the Regulations on Commercial Performances as amended by State Council Order 732)
sources.said: 第十五条 举办外国的文艺表演团体、个人参加的营业性演出，演出举办单位应当向演出所在地省、自治区、 直辖市人民政府文化主管部门提出申请。 … 国务院文化主管部门或者省、自治区、直辖市人民政府文化主管部门应当自受理申请之日起 20 日内作出决定。 … 《营业性演出管理条例》（国务院令第 439 号公布，国务院令第 528 号、第 638 号、第 666 号、第 732 号修订）

note: For a commercial performance the organiser asks the provincial culture department's approval and the performer then takes the work visa (Z) on that approval and an approval of short-term employment; film or television work outside a commercial performance takes the Z visa on the Notice of Foreigner's Work Permit. Fees, times and validity weren't found in a source this client could read. Retry 2026-11-01: the 20 days are the provincial culture department's decision on the organiser's application, counted from acceptance (Regulations on Commercial Performances art. 15, as quoted in Quanzhou's official list of powers); the work-permit and Z-visa steps that follow have their own times, not found.
